description: Mirror parts, bodies or faces across a plane.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

entities.description: FeatureScript query selecting what to mirror.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Mirror").

plane_ids.description: Deterministic id of the mirror plane, e.g. JCC for Front.

plane_query.description: FeatureScript query selecting the mirror plane.

type.description: What kind of thing is being mirrored (default PART).

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_mirror
title: Mirror geometry
